events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, drawing hundreds of thousands to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Relive the vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off a weekend that defined a generation. What's your ultimate festival anthem?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of music icon Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define an era and inspire generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock'n'roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger to British rock.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Which 007 theme tune is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the music world lost one of its greatest showmen, Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the incomparable Freddie Mercury left us. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
